next.connectChat.title: Where this chat runs
next.connectChat.lead: On this machine, or on your computer through Harnessly Connect: commands and files are then that computer's. The chat keeps its history.
next.connectChat.none: No computer is connected: run harnessly connect code to get the install command.
next.connectChat.off: Harnessly Connect is not set up on this machine.
next.connectChat.onlyClaude: Only Claude chats can run on a computer through Connect.
next.connectChat.folder: This chat's folder is a computer's folder: it already runs there.
next.connectChat.busy: The agent is working: it switches when the turn is over.
next.connectChat.restart: The agent starts again there and goes on with the same history.
